headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited notified the NSE of timely interest payment on its publicly-issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with Regulation 57 of SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements.
implication: A routine Regulation 57 disclosure confirming debt servicing compliance; material only to debenture-holders and credit-rating surveillance, establishing no payment default or restructuring trigger.
detail: The company filed a formal intimation with the NSE pursuant to Regulation 57 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, certifying timely interest payment on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public offering and listed on the exchange. The disclosure is a standard regulatory compliance requirement for debt-issuing listed entities to maintain transparency with the market. No restructuring, default, or extension is indicated; this is routine debt servicing.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57
framework.note: Central. Mandates listed entities to make timely disclosures of debt servicing (interest/principal payments) to the stock exchange.
Governs the issue and redemption of debentures by public companies.
